message: Measured the current extension suite with Node coverage and audited test-to-source references.

diagnostics.message: Node reported 73.66% line, 56.78% branch, and 57.14% function coverage only across six loaded modules; unexecuted modules were omitted.
Extension activation and all server, parser, tokenizer, preprocess, completion, and utility modules have zero executed coverage in the extension suite.
22 production JavaScript files contain 10043 raw lines; the six loaded files contain 1720 raw lines. A raw-line-weighted whole-src estimate is about 12.6%.

message: Coverage audit completed without source changes. Extension diagnostics have partial unit coverage; extension activation and language-server behavior are untested.
